test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Choose the correct one word substitution for: "A person who renounces the world and lives in solitude".
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Recluse**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Recluse"** refers to a person who lives in solitude and avoids social interaction. (एकांतवासी)
 
 
• **Example:** The old man lived as a recluse in a small cabin deep in the woods.
 
 
• **"Recluse"** is the correct word for describing someone who renounces the world and prefers to live in isolation. (एकांत में रहने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** After the tragic loss of his family, he became a recluse, avoiding all human contact.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Reclus
